olivia-support: Escalation from @acme-ml — streaming JSON mode with Go SDK is producing parse errors and double-billing on a Dedicated account. Customer reports it only when proxy (nginx) is in path. Repro and captures below. Please triage.

mike-eng: assigning @sam-sdk and @lian-ml. Can you paste raw network capture? Is this only with keepalive/proxy or also direct to API?

olivia-support: Raw capture excerpt: ```
chunk1: b'{"id":"resp1","choices":[{"text":"Hel'
chunk2: b'lo"}],"finish_reason":"stop"}\n{'
chunk3: b'"id":"resp2","choices":[{"text":"Hi"}]}'
```
Observed behavior: Go parser fails when `}\n{` boundary is mangled by proxy buffering/flush. Error seen: `json: invalid character '{' after top-level value` coming from standard library decoder. Client then retries the request which resulted in duplicate tokens and billing spikes.

sam-sdk: We historically used newline-delimited splitting in the Go SDK (bufio.Scanner / strings.Split by `\n`). If nginx merges or strips newline we can get `}{` or partial fragments. Which SDK version?

olivia-support: Customer is on `go-sdk v1.4.2` and has `json_mode: true`. They run through an NGINX reverse proxy with gzip and `proxy_buffering` enabled. They saw this happen intermittently under load when gzip flushes occurred.

lian-ml: On the runtime side we emit NDJSON with `\n` terminators between objects. But network/proxy layer can coalesce or split chunks arbitrarily. The robust approach is to parse by JSON tokens, not by newline boundaries. Suggest change in Go SDK to use `json.Decoder` to decode successive JSON values from the stream. Also add defensive behavior: on parse error, avoid auto-retrying the whole request — surface error to caller and mark as potentially-retryable after inspection.

sam-sdk: I'll open an issue and prototype a fix. Plan: replace bufio.Scanner newline-splitting with `json.NewDecoder(io.Reader)` + loop Decode into raw json.RawMessage objects. That will accept back-to-back objects even without newline. Also add a test that feeds fragments that split inside multibyte UTF-8 and escaped characters.

mike-eng: P1 for Dedicated customer. @sam-sdk please link PR and add temporary mitigation (server-side tolerant decode) if feasible. Also verify behavior in TypeScript and Python clients (they might also do newline-splitting).

sam-sdk: Created draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk/pull/482 (draft). Test plan summary in PR: network-level fuzzing with varying chunk boundaries, run against captured stream from customer, ensure no parse errors and keep legacy behavior when `json_mode:false`. Also adding opt-out flag for strict newline semantics to preserve backward compatibility.

replay-bot: replay started: 1820004450. replay finished: 1820004789. Results: 0 parse errors with branch `fix/stream-json-decoder` using the customer's capture.

olivia-support: Customer applied the patch locally and confirms streams stopped failing and they no longer see duplicate billing. They're asking for a patch release and a KB note about proxies and gzip buffering. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

mike-eng: Follow-ups: (1) merge hotfix to go-sdk, (2) audit TS/Py SDKs for newline-splitting pattern and patch similarly, (3) add CI fuzz test for streaming JSON fragmentation, (4) publish KB and include in release notes. Assign owners and ETA?

sam-sdk: I can handle (1) and (4), ETA end of day tomorrow for hotfix branch and tests. I'll loop in @lian-ml for (2).

lian-ml: I'll run quick audit on ts-sdk and py-sdk today, will report back before EOD.

olivia-support: Documenting next steps for the customer and scheduling a follow-up call. Closing the escalation once hotfix is released.
